version: Official public old 20260409 build; not current Steam equivalence
source_type: Read local extracted scripts from official public package. Independent local implementation and own artwork.

normal_arrow.movement: Each physics step heads from previous projectile point toward current target global foot; travels speed*delta. Within one step distance, impact once.
normal_arrow.target_death: Invalid or health<=0 individual target immediately cancels the projectile; no hit effect.
normal_arrow.source_death: Invalid source does not cancel flight; damage receives null source. Original validity is object lifetime, not simply health.
normal_arrow.arc: No normal-arrow parabola. Sling changes drawing only.
normal_arrow.release_origin: Current shooter logical position plus renderer fire_origin; local uses baked anchors from own eight-direction models.
normal_arrow.hit_feedback: Blocked shots suppress ordinary bow-hit feedback; source target damage creates its shield feedback.

shield_at_arrival.direction: Current live source position relative to target, not initial launch direction.
shield_at_arrival.missing_source: No directional block / no source retaliation.

catapult.target: Fixed point from release, never homes.
catapult.splash: Alive opposing entities in inclusive radius; if source no longer exists, both teams. All receive same configured raw damage, then target damage/shield logic.
catapult.not_280: Unit resource projectile_speed 280 is not used by this runtime rock formula.

local_limits: Own baked weapon anchors are not original procedural render coordinates; crossbow anchor is weapon root, not measured bolt tip.
Source alive lookup uses hp>0 immediately; original node can remain valid until deferred death cleanup. Same-step destruction is not fully matched.
Legacy mountain/decoy extensions retained; full buildings and siege topology unimplemented.
Local impact sounds and rigid pixel animation differ; no original assets copied.
No exact original projectile speed, timing, RNG, or full trajectory equivalence claimed.
Fireball/healing projectile branches are present in reference; this pass covers configured ordinary arrows/sling and catapult, not all potential projectile branches.
